voices.name: l00
voices.text: A nurse in Australia <#0.2#> wrote down the regrets of people in their final days.
voices.caption: A nurse in Australia wrote down the regrets of people in their final days.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: The most common regret <#0.2#> wasn't about money or success.
voices.caption: The most common regret wasn't about money or success.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: It was this. <#0.3#> I wish I'd had the courage to live a life true to myself, not the life others expected of me.
voices.caption: It was this. I wish I'd had the courage to live a life true to myself, not the life others expected of me.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: The life you're living right now. <#0.3#> Did you really choose it?
voices.caption: The life you're living right now. Did you really choose it?

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Other people's expectations <#0.2#> aren't yours to carry for life.
voices.caption: Other people's expectations aren't yours to carry for life.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Today, <#0.2#> make even one small choice truly your own.
voices.caption: Today, make even one small choice truly your own.
